_note: Curated, reviewed regexes referenced from concerns.json by pattern_ref, so config authors never write raw regex. Shapes here are STARTING GUESSES; replace them with the real shapes reported by the discovery run (pipeline SP-1.1-05, patterns_found.json).

claim_number_generic.description: Claim number: 2-4 letters then 6-12 digits (optional separator), or a bare 8-12 digit run.

currency_amount.description: US dollar amount, optional $ and thousands separators. A bare integer only counts as money when a $ immediately precedes it, so '42 miles' is not an amount. The comma/decimal forms are listed first so they win over the bare-integer branch - an earlier version put '$\s?\d+' inside the group, which let a leftmost match starting on the preceding space capture just '$1' out of '$1,250.00'. See pipeline SP-1.1-39.

us_date.description: US date as M/D/YYYY, M-D-YY, YYYY-MM-DD, or 'Jan 5, 2026'.

invoice_number.description: Invoice or bill number, optionally prefixed.

bill_type_code.description: UB-04 type-of-bill code: 3 or 4 digits, commonly cited as 0111 / 131. The lookarounds keep it from matching digit runs inside a currency amount ('250' out of '$1,250.00') or a longer identifier - see pipeline SP-1.1-38.
